I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: **the depot was Southgate.**

- **Source:** On 3 Sep 2025, Pree posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots. She said Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she closed the incident and said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see all of this himself.
- **Not answered:** The channel doesn't give a city or address for Southgate, so I told him to ask Pree if he needs that before the call.
- **Left out on purpose:** The knowledge brain also has an incident report email about the same outage, sent from Pree to the customer. It points to the Tulsa yard, but it describes a frozen gate check-in screen, not stalled label printing. Tobias isn't on that email, so I didn't use it or mention it to him.
